title: Connected components
prompt:
Read an undirected graph from standard input: a first line `N M`, then M lines `A B`, each an edge between nodes A and B (nodes are numbered 1 to N; edges may repeat, and A may equal B). Print three lines:
`components=K` with the number of connected components (a node without edges is a component of its own),
`sizes: S1 S2 ...` with the component sizes from the largest to the smallest, separated by single spaces,
`largest contains node X`, where X is the smallest node number inside the largest component (if several components share the largest size, take the one whose smallest node number is lowest).
